name: LA VIE by thomas bühner

menus.name: Omnivore tasting menu
menus.note: Fish and meat. Also served as 4 to 7 courses, from €188; wine pairing €98–€178 depending on length

menus.name: Vegetarian tasting menu
menus.note: Also served as 4 to 6 courses, from €173; wine pairing €78–€148 depending on length

bookingOpens: Online through Zenchef from the restaurant's website, or by email to mail@laviebythomasbuehner.de.
cancellation: A credit card is needed to confirm a booking, and €250 a person is held on it. Cancelling is free up to 48 hours before; later than that, the whole deposit is kept.
groups: Groups of six or more book by email (mail@laviebythomasbuehner.de). The whole restaurant can be hired for private or business events (event@laviebythomasbuehner.de).
dressCode: Smart casual. Guests are welcome to dress up for the occasion.
children: Children are welcome if they can take part in the full meal. There is no children's menu.
duration: About 3½ to 4 hours for the full menu.
